rule: Preserve exact physical markers, scars, eye colors, armor materials, and signature weapons across all scenes without visual or psychological drift.
Show emotional turmoil through visceral physiological cues (acrid ozone, clenched jaw, trembling bowstring, bloodied dust) rather than naming emotions abstractly.
Maintain distinct speech cadences: ancient monarchs speak with solemn economy; conflicted warriors speak with clipped, breathless hesitation.
Anchor spatial geography with a Wide Establishing shot before cutting to Medium Tracking or Macro Close-Up. Never use identical shot framings back-to-back.
Ensure camera vectors complement emotional stakes: slow push-in for tragic realization, sweeping low-angle crane for monumental cosmic destiny.
MiniMax H3 overall_soundscape must strictly prohibit human dialogue to prevent unnatural lip-sync artifacting in generated video chunks.
Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo prompts must unname characters into concrete physical tags with explicit lighting temperature, volumetric depth, and anamorphic lens optics.
